newsitem.title: USA: CBOE, AMEX set new options listings for June 6.
newsitem.headline: CBOE, AMEX set new options listings for June 6.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Friday it will begin trading options on shares of insurer Hartford Life Inc on June 6.
The American Stock Exchange said it will begin trading options on American Depositary Shares (ADSs) of Amsterdam-based financial firm ABN AMRO Holding NV on the same day.
At the CBOE, Hartford Life options will open with strike prices of 30, 35 and 40, with introductory expirations in June, July, September and December.
The options will trade in the Citicorp trading crowd, the CBOE said.
ABN Amro options will have opening strikes of 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2 and initial expirations in June, July, October and January.
The AMEX said LETCO-Specialist LP will be the specialist.
